name: Authentic Archival Photography
description: Genuine period photograph in silver gelatin or albumen monochrome with warm sepia tones, authentic film grain, dust spots, thin scratches, faded contrast, and subtle lens vignetting. The photograph fills the full frame with no torn edges and no paper borders.
system_instructions: Execute as a genuine period archival photograph: Silver gelatin or albumen print tones, warm sepia or antique monochrome tonal range, authentic film grain, subtle chemical dust spots, thin hairline scratches, and natural optical lens vignetting. The photograph FILLS THE FRAME completely edge-to-edge. STRICTLY NO torn paper edges, NO frayed card borders, and NO paper margins (unlike century-old photograph style which features torn paper edges, this style has NO torn borders — the image IS the archival photograph itself). STRICTLY NO illustrations, engravings, or drawings. STRICTLY NO modern RGB saturated colors. Historical figures, architecture, tools, and attire must be period-accurate. Stills are held completely still with no zoom and no pan.
